methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 high-search exercise-bike models spanning indoor cycling, upright, and recumbent categories as of mid-2026. Primary sources are manufacturer product pages (onepeloton.com, schwinnfitness.com, bowflex.com, nordictrack.com, echelonfit.com, soletreadmills.com, keiser.com) corroborated by major review outlets (BarBend, Garage Gym Reviews, Fitrated). Prices reflect US MSRP or the current listed price on the brand's own storefront as of the access date; sale prices are noted where the manufacturer's page showed a promotion. subscription_required is true when on-screen content or primary class library is paywalled; false when the bike functions fully without a paid plan. Adversarial re-verification (2026-06-17) confirmed all 11 products exist and corrected several flywheel/resistance fields that were copied from the wrong (older) Peloton model, and fixed one broken source URL. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Peloton Cross Training Bike
products.priceNote: MSRP on onepeloton.com; seen at ~$1,295-$1,445 on Amazon as promotional price
products.provenance: Price $1,695, 21.5" Full HD swivel touchscreen, manual resistance knob, and 297 lb max weight confirmed directly on onepeloton.com/shop/bike. Part of the Cross Training Series refresh launched October 2025. Flywheel weight and discrete resistance-level count are NOT published by Peloton for this new model; the 38 lb flywheel / 100 levels in the draft belonged to the older Original Peloton Bike (different product) per BarBend's review — set to null here. All-Access Membership required for class content.

products.name: Peloton Cross Training Bike+
products.provenance: Price $2,695, 23.8" swivel touchscreen, auto-follow resistance (knob that auto-adjusts to instructor recommendations), and 297 lb max weight confirmed on onepeloton.com/shop/bike-plus. Bike+ adds auto-follow resistance, Sonos-tuned speakers, and an 8MP Peloton IQ movement-tracking camera vs. the standard Bike. Flywheel weight and discrete resistance-level count are not published by Peloton for this model (the draft's 38 lb / 100 levels were the Original Bike's specs) — set to null. All-Access Membership required.

products.name: NordicTrack S22i Studio Bike
products.priceNote: $1,999 on nordictrack.com; $1,899 bundle includes 30-day iFIT membership
products.provenance: 22" HD touchscreen, 24 levels of Silent Magnetic Resistance, 350 lb max weight, and price $1,999 ($1,899 with iFIT bundle) confirmed by BarBend 2026 review, Garage Gym Reviews, and nordictrack.com. iFIT subscription required for trainer-led classes. Manufacturer does not officially publish flywheel weight (reviews cite ~32 lb but this is unofficial) — left null.

products.name: NordicTrack S27i Studio Bike
products.provenance: Price $2,499, 27" touchscreen, 24 levels of magnetic resistance, and 350 lb capacity confirmed by BarBend 2026 review and Garage Gym Reviews. iFIT subscription required. Flywheel weight not officially published by NordicTrack (third-party reports vary ~29-32 lb) — left null.

products.name: Echelon Connect EX-5
products.priceNote: Current price on echelonfit.com as of access date
products.provenance: Current price $899.99 confirmed on echelonfit.com. 32 levels of silent magnetic resistance, 28 lb flywheel, and 300 lb max weight confirmed by Fitrated and BarBend. No built-in screen — device holder for personal tablet/phone. subscription_required is false because the bike operates in freestyle mode without an Echelon Premier membership; app access is optional (~$39.99/month).

products.name: Schwinn IC4 Indoor Cycling Bike
products.priceNote: MSRP $999; frequently on sale at $799 on schwinnfitness.com
products.provenance: MSRP $999 (commonly discounted to ~$799) confirmed on schwinnfitness.com. 100 levels of magnetic resistance, 40 lb flywheel, and 330 lb max weight confirmed on the official IC4 FAQ and BarBend. No built-in touchscreen — small LCD console. JRNY app is optional; bike functions without a subscription.

products.name: Schwinn 290 Recumbent Bike
products.priceNote: MSRP $999; currently on sale at $799 on schwinnfitness.com
products.provenance: MSRP $999 and $799 sale price, 25 magnetic resistance levels, 330 lb max weight, and 7" LCD display confirmed on the official schwinnfitness.com product page (URL corrected from the draft's non-existent /products/schwinn-290-recumbent-bike to /product/290-recumbent-bike/100948.html) and BarBend review. Flywheel weight not published by Schwinn. Release year not determinable. JRNY optional, not required.

products.name: Bowflex VeloCore Bike (22" Console)
products.priceNote: MSRP $2,199; currently on sale at $1,499 on bowflex.com
products.provenance: MSRP $2,199 and $1,499 sale price, 22" touchscreen, 100 levels of magnetic resistance, 33 lb flywheel, and 325 lb max weight confirmed on bowflex.com and BarBend 2026 review. subscription_required is false — JRNY offers free essential workouts with no subscription; premium membership optional. Unique side-to-side leaning frame. Source URL set to the canonical product page.

products.name: Keiser M3i Indoor Bike
products.provenance: Price $2,985 confirmed directly on keiser.com (fetched). 24 indexed magnetic-resistance gears, eddy-current (non-contact) resistance, 350 lb max weight, and 8 lb rear-mounted aluminum flywheel confirmed on keiser.com and third-party retailers. No subscription required — standalone M Connect display included. No built-in touchscreen.

products.name: Sole SB900 Indoor Cycle
products.priceNote: Official price on soletreadmills.com; currently listed as sold out
products.provenance: Price $1,199.99 (listed sold out), 100 resistance levels, and 300 lb max weight confirmed on soletreadmills.com official product page. Flywheel listed as 35 lb on the page (precise spec sheet value 35.27 lb retained); BarBend reports 48 lb but the manufacturer value is used. No subscription required; SOLE+ app provides free classes. No built-in touchscreen, compact LCD only.

products.name: BODi Bike (formerly MYX II)
products.priceNote: MSRP per BarBend 2026 review; MYX II branding discontinued, now sold as BODi Bike
products.provenance: MYX II was rebranded to BODi Bike; price $1,399, 41 lb flywheel, 350 lb max weight, and 21.5" swivel HD touchscreen confirmed by BarBend 2026 review. Resistance type is friction (manual knob), not magnetic. Discrete resistance levels not published — null. BODi app subscription required for class content (~$35/month).
